_contract.purpose: This file is the field list, not a demo. It is deliberately unbuildable.
_contract.why: Every value is an obvious placeholder so that a half-filled kit fails loudly instead of shipping plausible-looking numbers. build_statement.py refuses any document still carrying [TBD], DD/MM/YYYY or XX.XX.
_contract.one_statement_per_fund: A client holding 1212.Stable and 1212.Alpha receives two statements. 'fund' is required and appears in the cover, every page head, the statement reference and the file name.
_contract.cash: Cash held at account level does not belong on a per-fund statement. Attribute it per fund or leave it out, otherwise a client adding two statements counts it twice.
_contract.net_of_fees: Every figure here is already net of fees. NAV per share is struck after fee accrual. Never subtract the performance fee a second time.
_contract.reconciliation: Movements are inception-to-date, so the pre-send control is inception-to-date too: movements must reconcile with net contributions since inception, not over the period.
